note: Word Builder content. Each word: w = word, u = units [grapheme, phonemeId|null] (null = silent letter), p = picture. Phoneme ids come from content/sounds.json. Stages are cumulative: a word in stage c may use graphemes from a and b. Distractor tiles are generated at runtime from the stage's grapheme pool. tests/content.test.js validates every unit against sounds.json.

stages.name: ck, double letters, ng and nk
